svg.title: Scorpius — calibrated outline derivative
svg.desc: Scorpius outline derivative, 2026-10-09. Original: Johan Meuris, Stellarium constellation art (2005), Free Art License; vector tracing/calibration: Tran Vu Anh Duy portfolio / Codex. Modified silhouette/ink contours, grayscale, removed shading; not a recovered vector master.
